reviewed_by: Claude: goal dispatch failure diagnostics, focused goal-dispatch and diagnostics-classification selection
reason: A goal whose first or next turn could not be prepared paused with the fixed text 'Goal work could not start' and nothing was logged: the cause was validation-class (ChatConfigurationError when the goal's built-in tools do not fit the model context), which record_caught_exception records at Warning and the default Error level drops. record_caught_exception gains operation_failed, which keeps such a cause at Error; goal dispatch and automatic continuation use it and pause with the cause and error ID. Select the new dispatch-failure and pause-reason regression tests, the two existing dispatch/auto-continue tests that assert budget exhaustion is not a failure, the new and existing record_caught_exception classification tests, and the Kali inventory tests because its standalone fallback signature changed.
exclusions: No UI, setting, provider or native change, so frontend, Playwright and native layers are empty and the settings assistant is unchanged. Other goal and diagnostics tests do not reach the changed catch sites or the new flag. No full-suite approval.
